title: What is a Stock?
description: Learn the basics of what a stock actually is.

slides.title: A Slice of the Pie
slides.content: When you buy a stock, you're literally buying a small piece of a real company. You become a part-owner!

slides.title: Why do companies sell stocks?
slides.content: Companies sell shares to raise money to grow their business, build factories, or hire more people.

slides.title: How do you make money?
slides.content: You make money if the company grows and becomes more valuable (the stock price goes up), or if they pay you a portion of their profits (called dividends).

quiz.question: What are you actually buying when you purchase a stock?

options.explanation: That would be a bond, not a stock.
Correct! A stock represents an ownership stake.
